english: Looks like you're having a rough time, Jeanne~.
…You too.
I'm fine.\nIt'd be a problem if those guys\nwere small fry, after all.
…The client's orders are too hasty.\nThey don't suit my methods.
So you like it intense, huh.\nWhat a closet pervert~.
Silence.
Still as stiff as ever.\nBut hey—is that really the only reason\nyou're struggling?
…They're growing stronger.\nDifferent from when we fought before.
Okay, taggin' in Riko from here!\nYou think about your next move, Jeanne.
…You have a plan?
Rikorin's the flash-of-inspiration type!\nA light bulb just goes 'ding!' in my head.
…Do as you like.
Hey, Jeanne.\nLet me tell you something good.\nWhen you want time to work up a scheme…
You use people.
// Scene change\n// Battle map: Butei High (same as 005B)\n// Yase has already deployed her youkai army. Hold a defensive line and stop the advancing youkai army.
So this is Butei High. Anyone here?
I'm Yase. I heard\nKoto's staying with you?
// Aria appears.
More of 'em, crawling all over!
Demons and monsters in broad daylight.\nGives me the creeps.
They're the youkai that were all over Kyoto!
I don't plan on making a scene.\nI just want to talk to Koto.
Liar!\nIf you just wanted to talk,\nyou'd have come alone.
Koto isn't here!\nSorry, but please leave!
Hiding her won't help.\nI have solid intel that she's here.
Who'd you hear that from?
A reliable source.
So WHO is that!?
I canceled a tea party to come here.\nI can't go home empty-handed.
Rin, pack up the leftover sweet-and-sour pork\nin a container for her.
Good idea! My sweet-and-sour pork is delicious—\nwait, HEY!?
In times like these, you serve\nbubuzuke, not sweet-and-sour pork, right?
That's for when you want lingering guests to leave.
Um, should I just scatter some salt?
Not wrong, but a little too direct.
I'll forgive a little rudeness,\nso hand over Koto. Quickly!
She's not here, so she's not here. Leave!
Hmm… and I was trying\nto handle this gracefully.
Then I'll just have to\nsearch every nook and cranny!
Kyaa! Ghosts!!\nNooo! Scaryyy!
Teacher, you've always been\nreally bad at fake crying~…
Teacher, your eyes aren't scared at all!\nYou're so bad at this…
// Battle start
Hm? Someone showed up~.
Ooh, who could it be?
O-hohoho!\nThe reinforcements have arrived!
Oh, a rabbit person.
So that's one more monster.
I'm not a rabbit person OR a monster!\nI'm La Vie en Rose!!
Huh, wasn't she called Usada?
Oh yeah, that's right! Usada!!
I'm NOT Usada!!\nYou don't want to make me angry!\nI'll show you why right now!!
// Battle resumes\n// Yase leaves a few turns after Usada appears
That's a lot, even for us…
How many do we have to beat?
What if they just keep coming\nendlessly?
You say the scariest things\nso casually…
Hmm? That's odd.\nWith all this fun going on,\nKoto would absolutely come bursting out.
Is Koto really not here, I wonder?
That's what I've been telling you\nfrom the start!
I don't trust a word humans say.\nYou're all liars.
I'll think up a punishment for the twintail girl\nwho tricked me later. For now, I'm heading home.
Come on, everyone. We're leaving.
// Yase and the youkai army exit.
Huh!? You're leaving!?
Looks like you're the only one left.
You go home too!
What are you saying, bunny!\nHanging in there at times like this\nis how you earn points!
Come ooon! La Vie en Rose Corps!
// Usada summons grunts.
There are so many cuties~!!\nTeacher, I want one~!!
Nooope☆
Like fighting Kintaro candy come to life!\nWhere'd she get so many?!
A perfect chance to show that\nquality beats quantity, zo☆!
Just take 'em down, one after another!
// Battle resumes
Geez! I would've won\nif Yase hadn't left!
Looks like you miscalculated\nthe difference in strength. Good effort!
Y-you'll pay for thiiis!!
// Usada retreats from the front
Thank you, everyone.\nWe drove them off, thanks to you.
We're in your care as well.\nWe merely did what was expected, that's all!
Still, I don't get the enemy's goal.\nShe said she came to see Koto,\nbut was that really all?
Once she was convinced Koto wasn't here,\nshe just left. Maybe that really was all she wanted.
She said she heard it from a reliable source,\nbut who could that be?
She just got fed bogus info!
And what about La Vie en Rose\nshowing up as 'reinforcements'?\nWas she asked by someone?
Something smells fishy.\nI smell something weird lurking around.
So it's confirmed: Jeanne's after Louise and Shirayuki,\nand a youkai named Yase is looking for Koto.
Louise and Shirayuki shouldn't be alone—\nthey need to stick with someone.
What a pain.
Shirayuki, when you go take a bath,\ngive me a holler. Uncle'll wash your back. Gufufu!
A-ahh…
Sis, your hands are way too pervy!
Not me, no way!
Louise is fine. I'll leave her to Aria.
Why the different treatment?!\nIs it 'cause I don't have any?! Is that it?!
…Come to think of it, Yase said something\nthat caught my attention as she left.\nSomething about 'the twintail who tricked me'…
She did. That could be…
// Fade to black\n// Background: a deserted place (a bleak spot like an abandoned building) where Riko is.
Fufufu. What pushovers~.
That blonde youkai's simple too.\nTell her Koto's here and she believes it\njust like that.
And Usada does whatever I tell her right away.\nThanks to them, I bought time\nto invite those two.
…What do you want,\nRiko Mine Lupin the Fourth.
Adding 'the Fourth' on purpose is just snide, y'know?\nI'm getting to know you pretty well,\nTesla Violet.
How kind of you.
Nine still doesn't talk, huh.\nYou'd be more popular with boys\nif you were a little friendlier~.
You didn't call us here\nto drag us into such trivial talk, did you?
…The point.
For Riko's plan,\nI want to borrow something from you.\nKufufu…!
// Scene change\n// Background: a room (same as 022B, Aria's room)\n// Shirayuki alone in her room.
Jeanne's still after me…
I set out on this journey to help my friends,\nbut am I just being a burden instead…
// SE: doorbell chime 'ding-dong', then a door opening.\n// Soniko, Mion, Cecilia, and Houki appear.
Shirayukiii! Comin' in~!
So this is the pure student council president's room~\nUncle's getting all excited!!
S-Soniko!? And Mion too…
What are you doing, Houki!\nYou said you'd go yourself—\nwhy are you hiding behind us?
I-I did say that, but…\nI doubt the conversation would flow\nwith me around…
Cecilia… and even Houki…\nWhat's going on, everyone?\nIs something wrong at Butei High?
We're your bodyguards!
Bodyguards?
Yep. Figured it's better\nif you're not alone.
Soniko insisted on coming to Shirayuki's room,\nso I had no choice but to tag along…
Guarding while having girl talk—\nthat'd be fun, wouldn't it!
G-girl t-talk?
You know, the kind of talk\nonly girl friends can have together.
We eat yummy food till morning\nand talk our hearts out~!
I picked out the cake and tea!
I taste-tested the cake already,\nso no worries.
What? Do you have a problem\nwith my selection?
No no, I'm confident in my tongue too,\nI was just double-checking.
I've got lots of other snacks\nand side dishes ready too!
Oh… if I'd known you were coming,\nI'd have cooked something…
Mmm…
N-no, I'm going home after all!\nThis atmosphere… it's too much for me!
You mustn't, Houki.\nThis doubles as guard duty, you know?
Then I'll stand watch by the front door!\nThat works, doesn't it?
Nooope.\nWithout you, Shirayuki would be\nthe only girl-talk beginner here.
Hmm… so Shirayuki's not good\nat this sort of thing either?
Yes, I have no experience at all…\nI'd feel safer…\nif you stayed, Houki.
I-is that so… if Shirayuki asks,\nI can't refuse…!
(Fufu, bringing Houki along\nwas the right call.)
(Yeeep.)
If this were the Sonozaki house,\nI'd break out the sake and go all out!
We're underage, so no-no!
I'll serve the finest tea!\nBritish nobility are terribly particular\nabout their tea, you know?
But Aria's a coffee person, right?
She's no lady, I tell you!
Detectives are more of a coffee image, though.
Maybe it's her rebellious phase?
I think I understand.\nI too want to be free—\nnot bound by my ancestors' customs and rules.
Freedom's a tricky thing.\nWhat seems free can be confining,\nand the reverse is true as well.
Indeed.
Ugh, this is getting way too heavy!\nNo no! Soniko, change the subject!
Then let's go with the girl-talk classic:\nyour type of guy~!
Wha!?
Uh…
Huh? What's wrong?\nMion, you first.
Me!? Umm, let's see…
Funny and cool, I guess?\nAnd, like, kind…
Waaah! What's this!?\nI'm just saying normal stuff, but\nit's SO embarrassing!! Nooo!!
Next, Houki!
Me!? I… first of all,\na man must be strong. That's the baseline.\nStronger than me is the minimum…
B-but! A violent man is no good!\nThat's not what strength is.\nThe truly strong are kind as well.
(Wh-what is this…?\nI've never even been in love,\nso why are the words flowing so smoothly…?)
E-enough! What about you, Cecilia!
Mine's simple!\nI seek the finest gentleman—\none worthy of standing beside ME!
Knew you'd say something like that!
What I can't stand is a sniveling man\nwho fawns over me! Just looking at one\nmakes my blood boil!
Shirayuki's turn next!
I've always lived at the Hoshiga Shrine,\nso I don't really know boys.
But the boy who often appears in my dreams\ntakes my hand and leads me\nsomewhere.
I don't know what kind of boy he is, but\nif he appears in my dreams,\nmaybe that's the kind of person I'm wishing for…
Oooh! How romantic!
A maiden! We have a maiden here!
W-was that all right?
It was lovely.
I should've just stood by the front door…
Now then, on to the next topic.
Huh? It's still Soniko's turn, isn't it?
Indeed.
My ideal… is a seeecret~!
That's not fair!
Yes, we want to hear\nabout Soniko.
I can't do it!\nIt's too embarrassing…
Everyone else put up with the embarrassment.\nNo keeping secrets all by yourself.
All right, then Soniko gets a punishment game\nby club rules!
I agree!
A punishment game? What is it?
Fufufu, this!!
// [Event CG] Mion discovering Shirayuki's underwear
That's my underwear!!
Exactly! You're probably about the same size,\nso Soniko's gonna put on a fashion show\nhere in Shirayuki's clothes!
Whaaat!?
Underwear looks are obviously included!\nOoh, not just white but black underwear too!\nUhehe, this'll be fun~!
Nooo!!
That's a punishment game for ME too!
Houki, Cecilia, you two search for\nwhatever clothes she's hiding too!\nDress Soniko in anything you like!
This is getting interesting!
The shrine maiden outfit's nice, but\nthere might be more hiding.
Should've brought a camera.\nI'll make Shion bring one!
Stooop!!
//END
